text:
Carol will likely win because the seller materially misrepresented the car: the ad described a 1964 model but the car was a 1968. An "as is" clause disclaims implied warranties only, not express ones, and the ad's description of the car was part of the basis of the bargain (UCC 2-313). Of the choices, D is closest, though A is also plausible.

CONFIDENCE: 62
